prompt_text: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset mod_textura_vidro for a 2D side-view fighting game. Output one PNG 1024x1024. Input image 1 is the mandatory STYLE REFERENCE, not the composition to reproduce: match its high-resolution cel-shaded anime illustration, thick dark outline #15101C, two-tone flat shading, crisp restrained rim light and retrofuturist city palette. Orthographic strict side/front view, sunset light from the left; no perspective convergence. Subject: seamless tileable front-view texture of one material, flat even lighting, no perspective: glass curtain wall with thin mullions and cold reflections. Opaque full-bleed background as specified for this material/layer. Flat even lighting for seamless tiling overrides directional sunset lighting: all four edges must match, no vignette or isolated focal feature. No characters, HUD, readable text, watermarks, ground planes, cast drop shadows or unrelated props. Draw only the requested layer/components, ready for combination with separately generated assets.
